indicators.name: EMA stack (9/21/50/200)
indicators.settings: Exponential moving averages of 9, 21, 50 and 200 closes
indicators.what: Four moving averages from fast to slow. When they line up in order, the trend is clean.
indicators.how: Up = 9 above 21 above 50, and price above the 200. Down = the mirror. Anything else is mixed.
zones: Fast, medium and slow averages are lined up downward: a clean downtrend.
The averages are tangled: no clean trend on this chart.
Fast, medium and slow averages are lined up upward: a clean uptrend.

indicators.name: Price vs EMA 21
indicators.settings: Distance from the 21-bar EMA, in ATRs
indicators.what: How far price is from its short-term average.
indicators.how: Measured in ATRs (typical bar sizes), so it means the same in calm and wild markets.
zones: Price is well under the 21-bar average: sellers are clearly in charge on this chart.
Price sits under the 21-bar average: a mild downward lean.
Price is hugging the 21-bar average: no lean either way.
Price sits over the 21-bar average: a mild upward lean.
Price is well over the 21-bar average: buyers are clearly in charge, and price is stretched.

indicators.name: Price vs SMA 50
indicators.settings: Distance from the 50-bar simple average, in ATRs
indicators.what: How far price is from its medium-term average.
indicators.how: Above it = medium-term uptrend; below = downtrend. Far away means stretched.
zones: Price is well under the 50-bar average: sellers are clearly in charge on this chart.
Price sits under the 50-bar average: a mild downward lean.
Price is hugging the 50-bar average: no lean either way.
Price sits over the 50-bar average: a mild upward lean.
Price is well over the 50-bar average: buyers are clearly in charge, and price is stretched.

indicators.name: Price vs EMA 200
indicators.settings: Distance from the 200-bar EMA, in ATRs
indicators.what: Where price sits against its long-term average.
indicators.how: The classic dividing line: above it is a bull phase on this chart, below it a bear phase.
zones: Price is well under the 200-bar average: sellers are clearly in charge on this chart.
Price sits under the 200-bar average: a mild downward lean.
Price is hugging the 200-bar average: no lean either way.
Price sits over the 200-bar average: a mild upward lean.
Price is well over the 200-bar average: buyers are clearly in charge, and price is stretched.

indicators.name: ADX 14 (trend strength)
indicators.settings: Average Directional Index, 14 bars (Wilder)
indicators.what: How strong the trend is, whichever way it points.
indicators.how: Below 20 = no real trend (sideways). 25 and above = trending. Above 40 = very strong trend.
zones: Trend strength is low: the market is moving sideways on this chart.
A trend may be forming but is not established yet.
A real trend is in place on this chart.
A very strong trend: these often run further than expected, then exhaust.

indicators.name: RSI 14
indicators.settings: Relative Strength Index, 14 bars (Wilder)
indicators.what: Compares recent up-moves with down-moves, on a 0–100 scale.
indicators.how: Below 30 = oversold, above 70 = overbought, 45–55 = balanced. In strong trends it can stay extreme.
zones: Sellers have pushed hard: price is oversold and often due a pause or bounce.
Down-moves have been beating up-moves recently.
Up-moves have been beating down-moves recently.
Buyers have pushed hard: price is overbought and often due a pause or pullback.

indicators.name: MACD histogram
indicators.settings: MACD (12, 26) minus its 9-bar signal, in ATRs
indicators.what: Whether momentum is speeding up or slowing down.
indicators.how: Above zero = upward momentum growing; below zero = downward momentum growing.

indicators.name: Stochastic %K (14)
indicators.settings: Close within the last 14 bars’ high-low range
indicators.what: Where the close sits inside the recent range.
indicators.how: Near 0 = closing at the lows (oversold); near 100 = closing at the highs (overbought).
zones: Closing near the bottom of the recent range.
Closing in the lower half of the recent range.
Closing in the upper half of the recent range.
Closing near the top of the recent range.

indicators.name: Stochastic RSI
indicators.settings: RSI 14 within its own 14-bar range (0–1)
indicators.what: A faster, twitchier version of RSI.
indicators.how: Below 0.2 = oversold, above 0.8 = overbought. It flips often, so it is a timing hint, not a trend signal.
zones: RSI is at the bottom of its recent range.
RSI is in the lower half of its recent range.
RSI is in the upper half of its recent range.
RSI is at the top of its recent range.

indicators.name: Williams %R (14)
indicators.settings: Close vs the 14-bar high, from 0 to −100
indicators.what: The stochastic turned upside down.
indicators.how: Below −80 = oversold; above −20 = overbought.
zones: Closing in the lower half of the recent range.
Closing in the upper half of the recent range.

indicators.name: CCI 20
indicators.settings: Commodity Channel Index, 20 bars
indicators.what: How far price is from its average, against its usual spread.
indicators.how: Above +100 = unusually strong; below −100 = unusually weak.
zones: Price is unusually far below its average.
Price is unusually far above its average.

indicators.name: ATR 14 (volatility)
indicators.settings: Average True Range, 14 bars, ranked against about the last 30 days
indicators.what: The typical size of one bar. The ranking shows if today is calm or wild compared with recent weeks.
indicators.how: Low ranking = quiet (often before a big move). High ranking = wild (wider swings both ways).
zones: Bars are unusually small: a quiet, compressed market.
Volatility is normal for recent weeks.
Bars are unusually large: expect wider swings.
Volatility is extreme: moves can be violent in both directions.

indicators.name: Bollinger position (20, 2)
indicators.settings: Close vs the 20-bar average, in units of 2 standard deviations
indicators.what: Where price sits inside the Bollinger Bands.
indicators.how: −1 = on the lower band, +1 = on the upper band. Outside the bands = a stretched move.
zones: Price has pushed below the lower band: a stretched drop.
Price is near the lower band.
Price is in the middle of the bands.
Price is near the upper band.
Price has pushed above the upper band: a stretched rise.

indicators.name: Squeeze (Bollinger inside Keltner)
indicators.settings: Bollinger (20, 2 SD) inside Keltner (20 EMA ± 1.5 ATR)
indicators.what: A squeeze means volatility has compressed unusually tightly.
indicators.how: Squeezes often end with a sharp move. The squeeze does not tell you which way.
zones: Volatility is tightly compressed: a bigger move often follows, direction unknown.

indicators.name: Keltner position
indicators.settings: Close vs the 20-bar EMA, in units of 2 ATRs
indicators.what: Where price sits inside the Keltner Channel.
indicators.how: ±1 = on the channel edge. Outside = a strong, stretched move.
zones: Price is below the Keltner Channel: a strong drop.
Price is in the lower part of the channel.
Price is in the middle of the channel.
Price is in the upper part of the channel.
Price is above the Keltner Channel: a strong rise.

indicators.name: Relative volume
indicators.settings: Last bar’s volume vs the average of the last 20 bars
indicators.what: Is the market busier or quieter than usual?
indicators.how: Moves on high volume are more convincing; moves on low volume are easier to reverse.
zones: Volume is surging: something is happening.

indicators.name: Aggressive buyers’ share
indicators.settings: Share of the last bar’s volume from traders buying at market
indicators.what: Who is more eager: buyers or sellers?
indicators.how: Above 55% = buyers are pushing; below 45% = sellers are pushing.
zones: Aggressive buyers and sellers were balanced.

indicators.name: Money Flow Index 14
indicators.settings: Volume-weighted RSI, 14 bars
indicators.what: Like RSI, but bigger-volume bars count more.
indicators.how: Below 20 = money flowing out hard (oversold); above 80 = flowing in hard (overbought).
zones: Money has been flowing out hard.
More money flowing out than in.
More money flowing in than out.
Money has been flowing in hard.

indicators.name: On-balance volume (12 bars)
indicators.settings: Volume on up-bars minus volume on down-bars, last 12 bars, as a share of volume
indicators.what: Is volume arriving on rising bars or on falling bars?
indicators.how: Positive = volume backs the rises; negative = volume backs the drops.
zones: Most recent volume came on falling bars.
Volume is split between rising and falling bars.
Most recent volume came on rising bars.

indicators.name: Position in the 4h likely range
indicators.settings: Price inside the 4-hour 80% range (EWMA volatility, from the 4h block’s open)
indicators.what: Where price sits inside the range BTC is expected to stay in 8 times out of 10 this 4-hour block.
indicators.how: 0 = bottom edge, 1 = top edge. This range forecast is the one forecasting skill that tested well.
zones: Price is at the bottom edge of its likely 4-hour range.
Price is in the lower part of its likely range.
Price is in the middle of its likely range.
Price is in the upper part of its likely range.
Price is at the top edge of its likely 4-hour range.

indicators.name: Price vs VWAP
indicators.settings: Distance from today’s volume-weighted average price, in standard deviations
indicators.what: VWAP is the average price everyone paid today, weighted by volume.
indicators.how: Above VWAP = today’s buyers are in profit. ±2 SD = stretched far from the day’s fair price.
zones: Price is stretched far below today’s average price.
Price is below today’s average price.
Price is at today’s average price.
Price is above today’s average price.
Price is stretched far above today’s average price.

indicators.name: Funding rate (per year)
indicators.settings: Last 8-hour funding × 3 × 365
indicators.what: What traders holding futures pay each other every 8 hours.
indicators.how: Positive = buyers pay sellers (more demand to be long). Very high = crowded longs; negative = crowded shorts.
zones: Sellers are paying buyers: the crowd leans short.
Buyers are paying more than usual: the crowd leans long.
Buyers are paying a lot: longs are crowded and vulnerable to a flush.

indicators.name: Funding vs normal
indicators.settings: Latest funding against the previous 90 settlements (30 days)
indicators.what: Is funding unusual right now?
indicators.how: Beyond ±2 = an extreme that the rulebook’s crowding setups watch for.
zones: Funding is extremely negative: shorts are crowded.
Funding is extremely positive: longs are crowded.

indicators.name: Open interest, 24h change
indicators.settings: Change in total open futures positions over 24 hours
indicators.what: Are traders opening new positions or closing them?
indicators.how: Rising OI with a move = new money behind it. Falling OI = positions closing (often after a flush).
zones: Positions are building fast: leverage is rising.

indicators.name: Long/short accounts ratio
indicators.settings: Binance accounts holding longs ÷ accounts holding shorts
indicators.what: How the crowd of traders is positioned.
indicators.how: Above 1 = more accounts long. Very high readings are often read contrarian: the crowd is usually late.
zones: More accounts are short than long.

indicators.name: Fear & Greed index
indicators.settings: Alternative.me daily index (0–100)
indicators.what: A daily mood gauge for the crypto market.
indicators.how: Below 25 = extreme fear; above 75 = extreme greed. Extremes are often read contrarian.
zones: The market mood is extreme fear.
The market mood is extreme greed.

indicators.name: Futures premium
indicators.settings: Futures mark price vs the spot index
indicators.what: Are futures trading above or below spot?
indicators.how: A premium = eager futures buyers; a discount = eager futures sellers.
zones: Futures trade below spot: sellers are eager.
Futures trade in line with spot.
Futures trade above spot: buyers are eager.

indicators.name: Liquidations (15 min)
indicators.settings: Forced closes in the last 15 minutes vs the last day (recorded live since 20 Oct 2026)
indicators.what: How many traders were forced out by the exchange just now.
indicators.how: Bursts mark capitulation moments: sometimes the end of a move, sometimes fuel for more.
zones: More traders than usual are being forced out.
